about: Hill & Moin LLP is a personal injury firm with a single office in Manhattan.

The firm states that it works on a contingency fee, with nothing to pay unless the case is won; the first consultation is free; its intake line is open around the clock; it will visit clients in hospital or at home. It publishes material in English and Spanish.

subs.label: Experience
subs.evidence: Mean 18.5 years since admission across 4 of 12 named attorneys (longest 45, shortest 3) · NYS Attorney Registration database

subs.label: Roster verifiability
subs.evidence: 4 of 12 named attorneys matched to the New York register; bar numbers published on the bios

subs.label: Accountability
subs.evidence: no bar or trial lawyers' association named on the pages we read · no professional liability cover disclosed, which is not scored here: plaintiff firms in this market do not publish it, and an absence shared by every firm separates none of them

subs.label: Results published
subs.evidence: 48 results published on the firm's own site, counted from stated amounts

subs.label: Specificity

court_dockets.note: A docket search found 15 case(s) naming this firm alongside sanction or consumer-protection language, none of which is a finding against it: a firm appears in such a docket by arguing about sanctions, or by bringing consumer-protection claims for its clients.
